title: Underlying sets commute with abelian sheaf inverse image
statement: Let C and D be small categories with Grothendieck topologies J and K [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and let U : C → D be continuous. Suppose the constructed set-valued sheaf pullback L preserves finite limits. Let A be the constructed abelian sheaf pullback, and let V_J and V_K forget the abelian group structure of a sheaf. Then there is a natural isomorphism A ⋙ V_K ≅ V_J ⋙ L. No covering-family, finite-colimit or representable-flatness hypothesis is required beyond continuity and finite-limit preservation of L.

source.place: Section 00YR and Proposition 00YV (2); also sites-modules.tex, first paragraph of Lemma 04JC

proof.text: Apply sheavesAlgebraicStructuresAbelian on J and K, at universes u,u,u. Form equivalences EJ and EK from the two strict inverse identities, and retain their strict underlying-functor equalities and their sectionwise addition and zero equations.

For R = continuous set-valued pushforward, use its canonical Cartesian braided structure. Its terminal comparison inverse is the identity. Its product comparison hom is the identity by sectionwise precomposition; its inverse is the identity by the hom-inverse equation. The lifted right functor therefore uses precisely the sectionwise zero and addition.

Construct the underlying natural isomorphism e between FK followed by R.mapCommGrp and abelian pushforward followed by FJ, using the two strict forgetful equalities. After composing with the J forgetful identification, e equals R applied to the K forgetful identification. Cancel that J identification: the two sectionwise zero equations prove that e preserves the unit, and the two sectionwise addition equations prove that it preserves multiplication. CommGrp.mkIso supplies the group isomorphism (inverse preservation follows automatically for group objects). Underlying naturality and CommGrp.hom_ext prove naturality of this group isomorphism. Whisker with GJ and use FJ followed by GJ equal to identity to identify the transported right adjoint with abelian pushforward.

Use the constructed set-valued pullback adjunction from Mathlib and lift it with Adjunction.mapCommGrp. Finite-limit preservation supplies the required finite products on the left, and the right adjoint preserves limits. Compose with EJ.toAdjunction and EK.symm.toAdjunction, and transport the right functor by the proved pushforward comparison. The constructed abelian pullback is also left adjoint to that same abelian pushforward; Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq gives the comparison of left functors. Whisker by the abelian forgetful functor and compose associators with the strict underlying equalities of GK and FJ. The underlying left group lift is definitionally the set-valued pullback followed after forgetting, yielding the stated natural isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem sitePullback_abelian_underlying
    {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (K : GrothendieckTopology D) (U : C ⥤ D)
    [U.IsContinuous J K]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafPullback U (Type u) J K)] :
    Nonempty (sheafPullback U AddCommGrpCat.{u} J K ⋙
        sheafCompose K (forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ≅
      sheafCompose J (forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ⋙ sheafPullback U (Type u) J K)
